strategy.thesis: Korea's first dedicated cybersecurity fund-of-funds, launched in 2024 by the Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) via Korea Venture Investment (KVIC). Each sub-fund must invest ≥50% into companies with AI/zero-trust/convergence-security technologies, cybersecurity-company M&A, or overseas-subsidiary expansion. Offers downside protection (loss coverage up to 15%) and upside incentives (private investors up to 30% of excess returns) to crowd in capital.

program.eligibility: Cybersecurity innovation companies (AI/zero-trust/convergence security), cybersecurity M&A, overseas-expansion ventures

application.how_to_apply: GPs apply via Korea Venture Investment (KVIC) public RFP; startups raise from selected GP sub-funds

summary.en: South Korea's first dedicated cybersecurity fund-of-funds, created in 2024 by the Ministry of Science and ICT through Korea Venture Investment. As of 2026 it has committed KRW 30bn of government capital across three sub-funds (run by LF/Axis, Lean Ventures and Aon Investment) and invested KRW 12.7bn into 8 companies; ≥50% of each sub-fund must back AI/zero-trust/convergence-security startups, security-company M&A, or overseas expansion. A 2026 sub-fund (KRW 16bn) is under operator recruitment.
summary.local: 과학기술정보통신부가 한국벤처투자(모태펀드)를 통해 2024년 조성한 국내 첫 사이버보안 전용 모(母)펀드. 2026년 기준 정부 출자 300억원으로 3개 자펀드(LF·액시스, 린벤처스, 에이온인베스트먼트 운용)를 운영하고 8개사에 127억원을 투자. 각 자펀드는 AI·제로트러스트·융합보안 기업, 보안기업 M&A, 해외진출 기업에 50% 이상을 투자해야 함. 2026년 신규 자펀드(160억원 규모, 정부 80억원)는 운용사 공모 중.

strategy.thesis: Government information-security incubator/cluster opened in 2017 at the Pangyo Startup Campus (Business Support Hub) by MSIT and KISA to cluster security companies, universities and research institutes. Provides workspace, collaboration-support centre, security test-beds (IoT/ICS), commercialization support and direct connection of resident startups to market channels and investment — including lead security companies directly investing in promising tenants. Operation transferred to KISIA (public→private) in 2021.

summary.en: Government information-security incubator opened in 2017 at Pangyo by MSIT and KISA to cluster security firms, academia and research, and to incubate security startups with workspace, collaboration centre, IoT/ICS security test-beds and commercialization support. It explicitly links resident startups to market channels and investment, including direct investment by lead security companies; operation moved from KISA to industry body KISIA in 2021.
summary.local: 과기정통부와 KISA가 2017년 판교 기업지원허브에 개소한 정부 정보보호 인큐베이터/클러스터. 정보보호 기업·대학·연구기관을 집적하고 보안 스타트업에 근무공간·협업지원센터·IoT/ICS 보안 테스트베드·사업화 지원을 제공. 입주 스타트업을 시장 판로 및 투자(선도 보안업체의 직접 투자 포함)로 직접 연결. 2017년 KISA 운영에서 2021년 KISIA(민간) 운영으로 전환.

sources.title: 정보보호 클러스터 운영 — 보안 기업 성장 지원
sources.supports: 2017 opening at Pangyo, clustering of industry/academia/research, startup incubation, test-beds
sources.quote: 2017년 11월 30일 판교 ... 기업지원허브에 개소 ... 정보보호 관련 기업·대학·연구기관 집적 및 협업 ... 스타트업 육성 기반

sources.title: 판교 정보보호 클러스터 운영, 민간에 맡긴다…KISIA가 전담
sources.supports: operation transferred from KISA (public) to KISIA (private) in 2021; investment linkage incl. lead security firms
sources.quote: 정보보호 클러스터의 운영 주체가 한국정보보호산업협회(KISIA)로 ... 선도 보안업체가 직접 투자하는 방식

verification_notes: This is a government/association-run incubator (space + test-beds + investment matchmaking), not a direct equity investor. Specific tenant counts and any direct investment amounts not disclosed in sources.
